verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own knowledge base documents a workflows tool ('Create workflows in HubSpot to automate your processes'), so it has a first-party automation capability, but the evidence is a single thin mention. Nothing in the pack covers triggers or the specific actions the story asks for. Sequences and the AI agents' automatic CRM updates are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented trigger types (enrollment/event triggers), record-update actions, task-creation actions, internal notification actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
